target_customer: Robot foundation model and policy developers, and industry partners with robot tasks, who need real world evaluation and training data
problem: Robot policies are hard to evaluate and improve without real robots, so failures in deployment are found late. SE3 Labs tests policies on real robots and uses failures to decide what data to collect.
business_model: Services and data for robot policy evaluation and reinforcement learning on physical sandboxes (pricing not found)
product_category: Real world RL environments for physical AI

founders.name: Mark Chen
education: Stanford (robotics research, per YC page; degree not stated)

founders.name: Conan Yu
previous_startups: A data infrastructure company serving IMC Trading and OpenSea (name not given)

competitors.name: Robocurve (YC Summer 2026)
competitors.what: Independent benchmark for real world robot capability using physical hardware

competitors.name: RL Environment as a Service
competitors.what: Persistent real world RL environments, says it does not offer simulators

competitors.name: Runtime.si (YC Fall 2026)
competitors.what: Evaluation layer testing robot policies across simulated environments

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs robot fleets, standardized workcells and a policy connection loop, which combine hardware operations with ML data curation.

defensibility.rationale: Failure data and partner site sandboxes can compound, but evaluation services are copyable and simulation rivals are well funded.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: NVIDIA released simulation evaluation tooling such as Isaac Lab Arena; the company is an NVIDIA Inception member rather than a target. No acquisition recorded.

market_need_then: Robot foundation model teams in 2026 are raising large rounds for data pipelines and evaluation, and many startups address policy evaluation, showing demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses se3labs.ai. A different Munich company named SE3 Labs also exists.

identity.visual_style: Numbered sections and a five step checkpoint loop diagram

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found, and a better covered Munich company with the same name crowds search results.

outcome_analysis: SE3 Labs is a three person Fall 2026 YC company selling real world RL environments for robots. It has no disclosed funding, and its name collides with a Munich spatial AI company that raised a seed in June 2026. Both naming confusion and well funded evaluation rivals are risks, but there is no outcome yet.
notes: IMPORTANT name collision: search results about a 5.5 million euro seed led by Lakestar in June 2026 concern SE3 Labs of Munich (spatial AI for defense), a different company, and are NOT recorded as rounds here. The SE3 Labs website names no founders; founders come from the YC page, whose education field was empty so education is left blank except a Stanford research mention.
